gatoh.utils.utils.plot_graph

plot_graph(x_vals: dict[str, list[Any]], y_vals: dict[str, list[Any]], plot_type: str = 'line', show_fig: bool = False, x_label: str | None = None, y_label: str | None = None, title: str | None = None, save_path: str | None = None, vertical_x: int | None = None, vertical_name: str | None = None, horizontal_y: int | None = None, horizontal_name: str | None = None) → None[source]

A helper function that handles 2D plotting of data point, with possible separation by categories.

Parameters:

  • x_vals (dict[str, list]) – A <category : values> mapping that defines the values for the x-axis.

  • y_vals (dict[str, list]) – A <category : values> mapping that defines the values for the y-axis.

  • plot_type (str, optional) – The type of graph to plot.

  • show_fig (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if the graph should be displayed in the script output.

  • x_label (str, optional) – The label to give to the x-axis.

  • y_label (str, optional) – The label to give to the y-axis.

  • title (str, optional) – The title to give to the graph.

  • save_path (str, optional) – The path to save the graph image to.

  • vertical_x (int, optional) – An X-axis value specifying where a vertical line should be added to the graph.

  • vertical_name (str, optional) – A label for the graph’s vertical line.

  • horizontal_y (int, optional) – A Y-axis value specifying where a horizontal line should be added to the graph.

  • horizontal_name (str, optional) – A label for the graph’s horizontal line.

Raises:

NotImplementedError – If the input plot_type is invalid or not currently supported.
